author: Adobe Creative Cloud
description:
Across Creative Cloud apps, including Photoshop, After Effects, Illustrator, InDesign, Frame.io, Lightroom, Premiere, and Firefly, we're introducing AI Assistant (beta) to help cut down on the repetitive tasks that slow down your creative process. You drive all the decisions and we'll take care of the syncing, grouping, renaming, and more.
